summary: This tutorial introduces Mozilla Thunderbird, a simple email client available for various operating systems. It covers downloading and installing Thunderbird on Ubuntu Linux 12.04, configuring email accounts, and managing emails. Thunderbird supports multiple email accounts like Gmail and Yahoo, allowing users to download emails from different accounts into their local computer. The application interface includes a main menu with options and shortcut icons for functions such as getting mail, writing emails, and managing address books. Thunderbird is divided into two panels; the left panel displays folders from your Thunderbird account, while the right panel offers advanced features and options. To configure POP3 for Gmail, log in to your Gmail account, open a new browser, type www.gmail.com, enter your username and password, then click the settings icon, select settings, and enable POP3 for all emails.
